evidence_sources.description: Owner-supplied workflow with repeated audit, move, parity and reference verification phases. Public fixtures are synthetic.
Knowledge Operations triage and validation, Notion domain filing, and the AskJamie application status contract were compared.

changes.hypothesis: A bounded cross-surface location and reference contract covers recurring work absent from inbox triage or artifact-only validation.
rejected_alternatives: Duplicate interview matching in a new package.
Separate version comparison and final report packages before those jobs need independent contracts.
Place private record work in social posting.
refinements: Explicit identity, preservation and audience readback.
Source and destination guards, scope-limited link checks, and dependency holds.
Common observation evidence and identity-aware historical maps.
changes.verification: Review versioned development cases and record structural and catalog results. No behavioral uplift claim.
